inference.cluster_policy: Resample all seven nested-p observations for one seed as a complete trajectory, independently within each lattice size. Twenty fresh clusters replace rather than pool with the five-cluster discovery wave.
inference.crossing_policy: Retain no-crossing and multiple-crossing outcomes. Quote a conditional central 90% interval only with its topology support.
inference.cell_sign_policy: Classify an adjacent-size LER difference only when its central 90% seed-trajectory bootstrap interval excludes zero.
inference.selection_rationale: q=0.85 had broad, inconsistent high-p crossings; q=0.90 had no point crossing but failed the ceiling sign-stability gate; q=0.95 was ceiling-compatible. The seven-point high-p grid covers both q=0.85 point-crossing regions and adds 0.425 and 0.47 guards without adding a q midpoint prematurely.
inference.promotion_gate: No p_c(q), ceiling classification, or q_c bracket is promoted unless both L7/L9 and L9/L11 satisfy the registered 90% topology/sign gates. This wave may justify a later q=0.925 midpoint only after q=0.90 and q=0.95 endpoints are independently classified.

provenance_policy: Every shard must use one identical runtime/source cohort and pass syndrome fidelity plus start/end source-hash equality. This fresh 20-cluster wave is analyzed independently and is never pooled with the five-cluster discovery wave.
execution_gate: Passed 21/21 runner, dispatcher, analyzer, and recovery tests plus a three-job dry run on 2026-08-28. Production may start; every shard remains fail-closed on syndrome fidelity and source stability.
purpose: Smallest discriminating high-q honeycomb matrix for the unresolved q=0.90 to ceiling-compatible q=0.95 transition, while retaining q=0.85 as the finite-side guard and leaving square deferred.
